insert into analytics_ingestion_events( event_id, version, source_type, aggregate_id, occurred_at, payload_json, ingested_at ) values
(#{event.eventId}, #{event.eventVersion}, #{event.sourceType}, #{event.aggregateId}, #{event.occurredAt}, #{event.payloadJson}, #{ingestedAt})
mapper.select: select uniqExact(event_id) from analytics_ingestion_events final where startsWith(event_id, #{eventIdPrefix})
select uniqExact(event_id) from analytics_activity_facts final where startsWith(event_id, #{eventIdPrefix})

select count() from analytics_user_dimensions final where user_id in ( select JSONExtractString(payload_json, 'userId') from analytics_ingestion_events final where startsWith(event_id, #{eventIdPrefix}) and JSONExtractString(payload_json, 'eventType') = 'USER_DIMENSION' )

select occurred_at as bucket_start, toDate(toTimeZone(occurred_at, 'Asia/Shanghai')) as activity_date, user_id, username, organization, rd_department, department, workspace_id, agent_id, model_id, login_count, session_count, active_session_count, empty_session_count, continuous_session_count, user_message_count, assistant_message_count, run_count, succeeded_run_count, failed_run_count, cancelled_run_count, active_termination_count, valid_interaction_count, positive_feedback_count, negative_feedback_count, diff_proposed_count, diff_accepted_count, diff_rejected_count, tokens_input, tokens_output, tokens_reasoning, tokens_cache_read, tokens_cache_write, tokens_input + tokens_output + tokens_reasoning as tokens_total, duration_ms as duration_total_ms, if(duration_ms > 0, 1, 0) as duration_run_count, occurred_at as first_activity_at, occurred_at as last_activity_at from analytics_activity_facts final where occurred_at >= #{startInclusive} and occurred_at < #{endExclusive}
select from analytics_user_activity_hourly final where bucket_start >= #{startInclusive} and bucket_start < #{endExclusive}
select from analytics_user_activity_hourly final where bucket_start >= #{filter.startTime} and bucket_start < #{filter.endTime}
select from analytics_user_activity_daily final where activity_date >= #{startDate} and activity_date <= #{endDate}
select job_name, watermark_at, generated_at, status, message, coverage_start, coverage_end, attribution_mode from analytics_rollup_watermarks final where job_name = #{jobName} limit 1
select uniqExact(user_id) from analytics_activity_facts final where and user_id != ''
select count() from analytics_user_dimensions final where status != 'DELETED'
select count() from analytics_user_dimensions final where status = 'ACTIVE'
select toInt64(quantileExact(0.95)(duration_ms)) from analytics_activity_facts final where and duration_ms > 0

select feedback_id, user_id, username, organization, rd_department, department, session_id, run_id, message_id, rating, nullIf(reason_code, '') as reason_code, '' as comment, occurred_at as created_at, occurred_at as updated_at from analytics_feedback_facts final where order by occurred_at desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select count() from analytics_feedback_facts final where
select count() from analytics_activity_facts final where and status in ('FAILED', 'CANCELLED')

select capability_type as type, capability_name as name, count() as invocation_count, uniqExact(user_id) as user_count, countIf(status = 'SUCCEEDED') as succeeded_count, countIf(status = 'FAILED') as failed_count, countIf(status = 'STARTED') as incomplete_count from analytics_capability_facts final where and capability_name != '' and user_id != '' group by capability_type, capability_name order by user_count desc, invocation_count desc, type, name
select distinct organization as value, organization as label from analytics_user_dimensions final where status != 'DELETED' and organization != '' order by label
select distinct rd_department as value, rd_department as label from analytics_user_dimensions final where status != 'DELETED' and rd_department != '' and organization = #{organization} order by label
